When"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" dsh's agent loop routes a request to `provider: devin`, the adapter:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. Translates dsh's `GenerateOptions` (messages, tools, system prompt, images) into Devin's `GetChat"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"MessageRequest` protobuf
2. Streams the response from Devin's Connect RPC endpoint
3. Decodes each `"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"GetChatMessageResponse` frame into dsh's `StreamChunk` protocol (text deltas, reasoning deltas, tool"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"-call deltas, usage, finish)"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Token resolution"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The adapter needs a Devin session token (format: `devin-session-token$<...>`) to authenticate. It re"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"solves the token in priority order:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"1. **Settings panel** — set `token` in the dsh settings UI (marked as secret, auto-redacted in wire "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"responses)
2. **Entry config** — `config.token` in the plugin composition
3. **Devin CLI credentials"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"** — automatically read from `credentials.toml` created by `devin auth login`:
- Windows: `%APPDATA%"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"\devin\credentials.toml`
- macOS/Linux: `~/.local/share/devin/credentials.toml` (or `$XDG_DATA_HOME/"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"devin/credentials.toml`)
- Override path with `DEVIN_CREDENTIALS_PATH` environment variable"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"If no token is found, the plugin throws at startup with a actionable error message."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"All fields are optional — the plugin works out of the box once a token is available (via settings pa"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"nel, entry config, or credentials.toml)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"When the dsh settings service is available, all of the above can be adjusted at runtime through the "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"settings panel — changes take effect immediately (`live` applies). The `token` field is marked `role"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"('secret')` so it is automatically redacted in settings descriptors returned to wire surfaces."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Once configured, dsh's model selector will show `Devin` as a provider with available models. Select "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"any model in the dsh UI or route to it programmatically with `provider: devin`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Dynamic model catalog**: Fetches the live model list from Devin via `GetCascadeModelConfigs` RPC"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" (5-minute TTL cache), merging user-configured models as fallback. - **Text streaming**: Full text delta streaming with block assembly
- **R"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"easoning/thinking**: Reasoning content mapped to dsh's `reasoning` block type
- **Tool calls**: Devi"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"n tool-call deltas translated to dsh's `tool-call` blocks
- **Image support**: Vision-capable models"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" accept image inputs via dsh's attachment system
- **Token usage**: Input/output token accounting re"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ported to dsh
- **System prompt sanitization**: Identity-agnostic system prompt rewriting for cross-"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"model compatibility
- **Proxy support**: Optional outbound HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy
- **Settings pane"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"l integration**: Runtime-adjustable configuration via dsh settings service
- **Credential auto-detec"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"tion**: Reads `devin auth login` credentials when no explicit token is configured"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
